en: Album page containing four black‑and‑white picture postcards mounted on cream paper. The cards show views of the town of Mikkeli (S:t Michel) and surroundings: a street with large public buildings labeled "Guvernörshuset"; a panoramic view with a large church labeled "Prst. ja Vaplan Kirkko"; an elevated view over a riverside townscape; and a riverside bridge or pier scene labeled "Porrassalmi". Each postcard has printed captions in Finnish/Swedish and red type "Mikkeli – S:t Michel" plus handwritten German notes and dates from 1899–1902. At the bottom of the album page is a handwritten German title describing Eastern Finland and St. Michel dated March 1902.
